title: Silkweave Box configuration (box.json)
description: Shared Box settings in box.json, recursively overlaid by gitignored box.local.json. Keep secrets in the local file. Arrays replace; nullable values can be cleared with null. Keys starting with _ are notes.

agent.description: The system principal: the machine account every Box has. Choose it BEFORE the first boot; the id is locked once the warehouse exists and cannot be renamed. name and role may change at any time and apply on the next request.

id.description: Lowercase slug. Locked after the first boot.

role.description: admin lets the agent manage users, credentials and service config; docs/AUTH.md weighs the tradeoff.

brand.description: Product name and artwork. Baked into the SPA at build time (rebuild after editing) and read by the server at call time. Artwork paths are origin-relative files under apps/web/public.

name.description: Full product name: the browser title, the PWA name, the name in invites.

shortName.description: The PWA's short name, shown under a home-screen icon.

description.description: The PWA manifest description. May be blank.

wordmark.description: The text beside the mark in the shell and on the login page.

suffix.description: A lighter word after the wordmark. Blank for none.

logoUrl.description: The mark, an SVG or PNG under apps/web/public.

icon192.description: 192x192 PNG: the PWA icon and push notification icon.

icon512.description: 512x512 PNG: the PWA icon and the favicon.

appleTouchIcon.description: The iOS home-screen tile, pre-flattened (iOS renders PNG alpha as black).

backgroundColor.description: PWA splash background, a CSS colour.

themeColor.description: The browser chrome colour, a CSS colour.

server.description: Where this Box serves. A second Box on one machine must never be one default away from the first: give it its own numbers (apps/server/src/agent/loopback-guard.ts tells the story).

host.description: The interface the Box listens on. Default 127.0.0.1 (this machine only). Use 0.0.0.0 or :: to reach the Box from other machines, for example over a tailnet.

port.description: The port Nest serves on (the single browser origin).

vitePort.description: The Vite dev-server port Nest proxies in dev.

dashboardUrl.description: This Box's browser-facing origin, for links in invites and notifications, e.g. https://box.your-tailnet.ts.net:8190. Null: localhost on the port above.

vscodeRemoteHost.description: ssh host for Open-in-VS-Code links over Remote-SSH (box, or you@box). Null: local file links.

gcsBucket.description: A private GCS bucket (no gs:// prefix) every warehouse backup is also uploaded to, with your ambient gcloud credentials. Null: local backups only.

background.description: Background work is OFF unless armed here. A dev checkout holding production credentials would otherwise run real schedules and real agent turns off test data. Core never reads these; the automation, chat and relay apps do, and typegen forces all three off.

automation.description: Arms the cron scheduler on the PRODUCTION Box only.

chatAgent.description: Arms the in-chat agent. Its own switch, deliberately: tying it to the scheduler would mean testing the chat agent also arms every cron.

stack.description: Where this Box's Silkweave Stack lives: the source an agent reads features/<id> implementation from when adapting a recipe. The Box itself ships recipes/ (docs and screenshots); box stack where shows the resolved location and box stack fetch makes the source readable locally (git sources are cached in the gitignored .stack/ directory). The Stack repository is internal today and will become public later; point this at a checkout or remote you can read. Override it per machine in box.local.json.

source.description: GitHub shorthand owner/repo (https://github.com/owner/repo.git), a git URL (https://, ssh://, git@host:path, file://), or a filesystem path: absolute, ~/..., or relative to the Box root with ./ or ../ (for example ..). A bare owner/repo always means GitHub.

recipes.description: The recipe ledger: every recipe this Box has adapted and validated, keyed by recipe id, with the powerups added and verified for it. The agent that adapts a recipe or adds a powerup records it here once its validation passes, and removes the entry when it is taken out. The Recipe Gallery reads it to show adapted recipes and to unlock powerups. Keep it in box.json (tracked), not box.local.json.

powerups.description: Ids of the powerups (folders under recipes/<id>/powerups/) added to this recipe.
